# coaching-ext@0.1 (parity fixture)

**Not a shipped pack.** This directory is the #449 parity fixture: an
external v2 copy of the compiled `coaching@0.1` checks, used by
`crates/confidant-core/tests/check_engine.rs` to prove the declarative rule
kinds reproduce compiled coaching. The real pack, once core owns
`context_view`, the PII fields and verb validation, is named `coaching`.

Declared in a test vault as `packs = ["coaching-ext@0.1"]`. The
machine-readable source of the pack's claims is
[`manifest.toml`](manifest.toml) (spec `spec/pack-manifest.md`): verbs,
balance metrics, finding codes, `[checks]` keys, `[[rules]]` and message
templates all live there. The folds and rule logic stay in core Rust.

External packs cannot claim a builtin finding code (PD13), so the codes
here are `E_COACHING_EXT_*` / `W_COACHING_EXT_UNTAGGED`; the parity tests
normalise them one-to-one onto the compiled codes
(`E_COACHING_EXT_BALANCE` → `E_BALANCE_MISMATCH`, and so on).

## Verbs

### `open`

```
DATE open PERSON-ID package PKG-ID N sessions
```

Opens (or renews) a package of `N` sessions for a person. `PKG-ID` uses the
`pkg-` prefix. Multiple `open` lines accumulate. `N` is a positive integer
capped at 100000. An invalid `PKG-ID` is `E_COACHING_EXT_ID`; a non-`pkg-`
id is `E_COACHING_EXT_TYPE`. Overflow or a malformed line is
`E_COACHING_EXT_OPEN`.

### `session`

```
DATE session PERSON-ID DURATION [paid|pps|comp] [note:NOTE-ID] [src:PROVENANCE]
```

`paid` consumes a package slot; `pps` and `comp` never consume. A session
with none of these tags still consumes and gets `W_COACHING_EXT_UNTAGGED`;
more than one is `E_COACHING_EXT_TAGS`. A session without a parseable
duration is `E_COACHING_EXT_DURATION` (key `coaching-ext.require_duration`).

`note:NOTE-ID` links a note that belongs to the session's person: an invalid
id is `E_COACHING_EXT_NOTE_ID`, a non-note id is `E_COACHING_EXT_NOTE_TYPE`,
and a missing or foreign note is `E_COACHING_EXT_UNKNOWN`. These checks
always run.

## Metrics

| Metric | Formula |
|---|---|
| `sessions_remaining` | sum(`N` from `open` on or before the date) − count(consuming `session`s on or before that date) |
| `icf_hours` | sum(session durations on or before the date, in minutes) / 60, compared at 2 decimal places |

A disagreeing `balance` line is `E_COACHING_EXT_BALANCE`; a negative
`sessions_remaining` is `E_COACHING_EXT_NEGATIVE` (key
`coaching-ext.balance_nonnegative`); a malformed value is
`E_COACHING_EXT_PARSE`.

## Gap rules

`E_COACHING_EXT_NOTES` (key `coaching-ext.session_notes`) fires for an
uncovered session. `E_COACHING_EXT_GAP` (key `coaching-ext.paid_session_gap`)
fires when a paid client has no session inside
`coaching-ext.paid_session_gap_days` days; `pps` clients are recognised
within `coaching-ext.pps_lookback_days`.

## Find / privacy

This pack does not change core `find` rules. Spec 0.1 sections 12–13 apply;
the rules read ledger metadata and note ids/paths/dates only.
